# posts-service

A blogging backend.

> Generated by the Autonomous AI Software Engineering Platform (offline provider).
> Review the code before deploying it anywhere that matters.

## Run locally

```bash
python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e . pytest httpx2 ruff
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
```

Open http://localhost:8000/docs for the interactive OpenAPI UI.

## Database migrations

The schema is owned by Alembic (`migrations/`); the app never creates tables itself.

```bash
alembic upgrade head                              # apply every migration
alembic revision --autogenerate -m "add a column" # after changing app/models.py
alembic downgrade -1                              # roll the last one back
```

`DATABASE_URL` selects the database (SQLite `./app.db` by default). The container runs
`alembic upgrade head` before it starts the server.

## Test

```bash
ruff check . && pytest
```

The suite builds its database with the migrations, and `tests/test_migrations.py` checks
that they upgrade, match the models, and downgrade cleanly. Set `TEST_DATABASE_URL` to run
that check against PostgreSQL too.

## Container

```bash
docker build -t posts-service:local .
docker run --rm -p 8000:8000 posts-service:local
```

## API

| Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET` | `/healthz` | Liveness probe |
| `GET` | `/posts` | List posts |
| `POST` | `/posts` | Create a post |
| `GET` | `/posts/{post_id}` | Get one post |
| `PATCH` | `/posts/{post_id}` | Update a post |
| `DELETE` | `/posts/{post_id}` | Delete a post |
| `GET` | `/comments` | List comments |
| `POST` | `/comments` | Create a comment |
| `GET` | `/comments/{comment_id}` | Get one comment |
| `PATCH` | `/comments/{comment_id}` | Update a comment |
| `DELETE` | `/comments/{comment_id}` | Delete a comment |

## Deployment

* `deploy/k8s/` - Kustomize base (Deployment, Service). Set `DATABASE_URL` through the
  referenced Secret.
* `deploy/terraform/` - AWS ECR + ECS Fargate service. Run `terraform init && terraform
  plan` with your own VPC and subnets; nothing is applied automatically.

See `ARCHITECTURE.md` for components and design decisions.

"""SQLAlchemy ORM models."""

from datetime import UTC, datetime

from sqlalchemy import Boolean, DateTime, ForeignKey, Integer, String, Text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

from app.db import Base


def _utcnow() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


class Post(Base):
    __tablename__ = "posts"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    title: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    published: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False)
    published_at: Mapped[datetime | None] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), nullable=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)


class Comment(Base):
    __tablename__ = "comments"

    id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(Integer, primary_key=True)
    author: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(255), nullable=False)
    body: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=False)
    approved: Mapped[bool] = mapped_column(Boolean, nullable=False)
    post_id: Mapped[int] = mapped_column(ForeignKey("posts.id", ondelete="CASCADE"), index=True)
    created_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTime(timezone=True), default=_utcnow)

"""Alembic environment: the models' metadata and DATABASE_URL."""

from logging.config import fileConfig

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, text

import app.models  # noqa: F401  (registers every table on Base.metadata)
from app.db import DATABASE_URL, Base

config = context.config
if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name, disable_existing_loggers=False)

# Serialises concurrent upgrades (several replicas starting at once) on PostgreSQL.
_LOCK_ID = 4_204_207


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(url=DATABASE_URL, target_metadata=Base.metadata, literal_binds=True)
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    engine = create_engine(DATABASE_URL)
    with engine.connect() as connection:
        postgres = connection.dialect.name == "postgresql"
        if postgres:
            connection.execute(text("SELECT pg_advisory_lock(:id)"), {"id": _LOCK_ID})
            # The lock is held by the session, so it outlives this transaction; ending it
            # here lets Alembic run (and commit) the migrations in a transaction of its own.
            connection.commit()
        context.configure(
            connection=connection,
            target_metadata=Base.metadata,
            render_as_batch=connection.dialect.name == "sqlite",
            compare_type=True,
        )
        with context.begin_transaction():
            context.run_migrations()
        if postgres:
            connection.execute(text("SELECT pg_advisory_unlock(:id)"), {"id": _LOCK_ID})
            connection.commit()
    engine.dispose()


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()

import sqlalchemy as sa
from alembic import op

revision: str = "0001"

def upgrade() -> None:
    op.create_table(
        "posts",
        sa.Column("id", sa.Integer(), nullable=False),
        sa.Column("title", sa.String(length=255), nullable=False),
        sa.Column("body", sa.Text(), nullable=False),

"""The migrations upgrade a fresh database, match the models exactly, and downgrade cleanly.

Runs on SQLite always, and on PostgreSQL too when TEST_DATABASE_URL points at a database that
may be emptied (for example postgresql+psycopg://app:app@localhost:5432/app_test).
"""

import os
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from alembic import command
from alembic.autogenerate import compare_metadata
from alembic.config import Config
from alembic.runtime.migration import MigrationContext
from sqlalchemy import create_engine, inspect

from app.db import Base

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
POSTGRES_URL = os.getenv("TEST_DATABASE_URL", "")


@pytest.fixture(params=["sqlite", "postgresql"])
def database(
    request: pytest.FixtureRequest, tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> tuple[Config, str]:
    if request.param == "sqlite":
        url = f"sqlite:///{(tmp_path / 'migrations.db').as_posix()}"
    elif POSTGRES_URL:
        url = POSTGRES_URL
    else:
        pytest.skip("set TEST_DATABASE_URL to check the migrations on PostgreSQL")
    monkeypatch.setattr("app.db.DATABASE_URL", url)  # migrations/env.py reads it per run
    config = Config(str(ROOT / "alembic.ini"))
    config.set_main_option("script_location", str(ROOT / "migrations"))
    command.downgrade(config, "base")  # start from nothing, even on a reused database
    return config, url


def test_upgrade_matches_the_models_and_downgrade_removes_everything(
    database: tuple[Config, str],
) -> None:
    config, url = database
    command.upgrade(config, "head")
    engine = create_engine(url)
    try:
        with engine.connect() as connection:
            drift = compare_metadata(MigrationContext.configure(connection), Base.metadata)
        assert drift == [], drift
        command.downgrade(config, "base")
        assert set(inspect(engine).get_table_names()) <= {"alembic_version"}
        command.upgrade(config, "head")
        assert set(Base.metadata.tables) <= set(inspect(engine).get_table_names())
        command.downgrade(config, "base")
    finally:
        engine.dispose()
files.description: Migrations upgrade, match the models and downgrade

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

PAYLOAD = {
    "title": "example title",
    "body": "Some longer body text.",
    "published": True,
    "published_at": "2025-01-15T09:30:00Z",
}


def test_create_and_get_post(client: TestClient) -> None:
    response = client.post("/posts", json=PAYLOAD)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    created = response.json()
    assert created["title"] == "example title"
    assert created["body"] == "Some longer body text."
    assert created["published"] is True
    fetched = client.get(f"/posts/{created['id']}")
    assert fetched.status_code == 200
    assert fetched.json()["id"] == created["id"]


def test_list_post_supports_pagination(client: TestClient) -> None:
    for _ in range(3):
        assert client.post("/posts", json=PAYLOAD).status_code == 201
    page = client.get("/posts", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 1})
    assert page.status_code == 200
    assert len(page.json()) == 2


def test_update_post(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/posts", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    response = client.patch(f"/posts/{created['id']}", json={"title": "updated title"})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["title"] == "updated title"


def test_delete_post(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/posts", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    assert client.delete(f"/posts/{created['id']}").status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/posts/{created['id']}").status_code == 404


def test_unknown_post_returns_404(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.get("/posts/999999").status_code == 404


def test_create_post_rejects_missing_required_fields(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.post("/posts", json={}).status_code == 422


def test_update_post_rejects_null_required_field(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/posts", json=PAYLOAD).json()
    response = client.patch(f"/posts/{created['id']}", json={"title": None})
    assert response.status_code == 422

from typing import Any

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

PAYLOAD = {
    "author": "example author",
    "body": "Some longer body text.",
    "approved": True,
}
POST = {
    "title": "example title",
    "body": "Some longer body text.",
    "published": True,
    "published_at": "2025-01-15T09:30:00Z",
}


def _make_post(client: TestClient) -> dict[str, Any]:
    response = client.post("/posts", json=POST)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    created: dict[str, Any] = response.json()
    return created


def _payload(client: TestClient) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        **PAYLOAD,
        "post_id": _make_post(client)["id"],
    }


def test_create_and_get_comment(client: TestClient) -> None:
    payload = _payload(client)
    response = client.post("/comments", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 201, response.text
    created = response.json()
    assert created["author"] == "example author"
    assert created["body"] == "Some longer body text."
    assert created["approved"] is True
    assert created["post_id"] == payload["post_id"]
    fetched = client.get(f"/comments/{created['id']}")
    assert fetched.status_code == 200
    assert fetched.json()["id"] == created["id"]


def test_list_comment_supports_pagination(client: TestClient) -> None:
    for _ in range(3):
        assert client.post("/comments", json=_payload(client)).status_code == 201
    page = client.get("/comments", params={"limit": 2, "offset": 1})
    assert page.status_code == 200
    assert len(page.json()) == 2


def test_update_comment(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/comments", json=_payload(client)).json()
    response = client.patch(f"/comments/{created['id']}", json={"author": "updated author"})
    assert response.status_code == 200
    assert response.json()["author"] == "updated author"


def test_delete_comment(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/comments", json=_payload(client)).json()
    assert client.delete(f"/comments/{created['id']}").status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/comments/{created['id']}").status_code == 404


def test_unknown_comment_returns_404(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.get("/comments/999999").status_code == 404


def test_create_comment_rejects_missing_required_fields(client: TestClient) -> None:
    assert client.post("/comments", json={}).status_code == 422


def test_comment_keeps_its_post(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/comments", json=_payload(client)).json()
    response = client.patch(f"/comments/{created['id']}", json={"post_id": None})
    assert response.status_code == 422


def test_comment_requires_an_existing_post(client: TestClient) -> None:
    payload = {**_payload(client), "post_id": 999999}
    response = client.post("/comments", json=payload)
    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert response.json()["detail"] == "Post 999999 not found"


def test_comments_can_be_filtered_by_post(client: TestClient) -> None:
    mine = _payload(client)
    assert client.post("/comments", json=mine).status_code == 201
    assert client.post("/comments", json=_payload(client)).status_code == 201
    page = client.get("/comments", params={"post_id": mine["post_id"]})
    assert [row["post_id"] for row in page.json()] == [mine["post_id"]]


def test_deleting_a_post_deletes_its_comments(client: TestClient) -> None:
    created = client.post("/comments", json=_payload(client)).json()
    parent = f"/posts/{created['post_id']}"
    assert client.delete(parent).status_code == 204
    assert client.get(f"/comments/{created['id']}").status_code == 404

FROM python:3.12-slim AS build
ENV PIP_NO_CACHE_DIR=1 PIP_DISABLE_PIP_VERSION_CHECK=1
WORKDIR /src
RUN python -m venv /opt/venv
ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./
COPY app ./app
RUN pip install .

FROM python:3.12-slim AS runtime
ENV PATH=/opt/venv/bin:$PATH PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
RUN useradd --uid 10001 --create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin app
COPY --from=build /opt/venv /opt/venv
WORKDIR /home/app
COPY alembic.ini ./
COPY migrations ./migrations
USER 10001
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=10s --retries=3 \
  CMD ["python", "-c", "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz', timeout=3)"]
# Migrations first (a PostgreSQL advisory lock makes replicas that start together apply
# them once), then the server replaces the shell as PID 1.
CMD ["sh", "-c", "alembic upgrade head && exec uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000"]

    steps:
